description: Resource workload view for a Gantt schedule. Computes per-assignee daily allocation from the tasks and working schedule and renders it as a grid across a rolling multi-week date window, highlighting weekends.

parameters.name: Today
parameters.description: Today's date in the display zone — caps the rolling window at (today − 7 days) and seeds it when no data exists. TmGantt passes the user-zone today.
